recoveryDispositions.reason: This earlier statement has no arbitrary computable parameter prefactor. It does not exclude the historical running time for every source-admissible recursive prefactor.

The source W[1] result uses the candidate-space exponent and a fixed polynomial complete-input factor. Transferring the full-input exponent would require a separate bound on encoding length in the relevant hardness construction.
The earlier W[1] theorem supplies the exact same clock without invoking the later source convention. The later theorem is recorded separately with its admitted prefactors and effectiveness scope.
